Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Gaurav Singh, learned counsel
for the applicant through video
conferencing.
Mr. Nikhil Bisht, learned Brief
Holder for the State of Uttarakhand.
2. The present Bail Application has
been moved by the applicant, who is in
judicial custody in connection with FIR
No. 319 of 2026, registered at Police
Station Kotwali Roorkee, District
Haridwar, for the offences punishable
under Sections 3/5/11 of the
Uttarakhand Protection of Cow Progeny
Act, 2007.
3. Heard learned counsel for the
parties and perused the record.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant
submits that the applicant is innocent
and has been falsely implicated in the
present case. It is further submitted that
the applicant was not arrested at the
spot and has been implicated in the
present case solely on the basis of the
informant's allegations.
5. Per contra, learned State Counsel
has opposed the Bail Application,
contending that the applicant has a
criminal history involving offences of a
similar nature.
6. Having heard learned counsel for
the parties and upon perusal of the
material available on record, this Court
finds that, having regard to the overall

UKHC010185982026
2026:UHC:9511
facts and circumstances of the case,
particularly the fact that the applicant
was not arrested at the spot and has
been implicated in the present case on
the basis of the informant's allegations, a
case for grant of bail is made out.
Accordingly, without expressing any
opinion on the merits of the case, this
Court is of the view that the applicant
deserves to be enlarged on bail.
7. Accordingly, the Bail Application is
allowed.
8. Let the applicant be released on
bail upon furnishing a personal bond
and two reliable sureties, each in the like
amount, to the satisfaction of the court
concerned.
9. It is made clear that any
observation made hereinabove is
confined to the adjudication of the
present Bail Application and shall not be
construed as an expression of opinion on
the merits of the case.
10. All pending applications, if any,
stand disposed of accordingly.
(Alok Mahra, J.)
